Name: CJB Show Item Sell Price
Author: Pathoschild
Description:
[b]CJB Show Item Sell Price[/b] shows the sell price of items in your inventory:

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CJBok/SDV-Mods/master/CJBShowItemSellPrice/docs/screenshot.gif[/img]
[b][color=#6aa84f]Non-English translations are bundled with the mod. [url=https://github.com/CJBok/SDV-Mods#translating-the-mods]Contributions are welcome[/url]![/color][/b]


[size=6][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
Then point at an item in your inventory/hotbar, and the price will be shown next to the cursor.


[size=6][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later on Linux/macOS/Windows.[/*]
[*]This is fully compatible with the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Price_Catalogue]Price Catalogue[/url] added in Stardew Valley 1.6.15. The price catalogue will show the total price in the tooltip, while this mod will show the unit + total price next to it.[/*]
[*]Works in single-player and multiplayer.[/*]
[*]No known mod conflicts.[/*]
[/list]

[b][size=6]Security[/size][/b]
This mod is fully [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Open_source]open-source[/url]. All its source code is public, so anyone can verify that it's not doing anything malicious.

Each release also has a [url=https://docs.github.com/en/actions/concepts/security/artifact-attestations]public attestation[/url], an unfalsifiable record which proves exactly how the release file was created. That lets anyone verify that it [i]only[/i] contains the public code, and hasn't been modified in any way.
